steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: GCSE RS requires you to understand both scientific and religious explanations for the origins of the universe, and how they relate to each other. | RS Exam Tips — The Origins of the Universe: 1. For The Origins of the Universe questions, always include specific scriptural or source references where relevant 2. Explain both religious and non-religious viewpoints 3. Use specialist vocabulary precisely (e.g. terms from the specification) 4. Evaluate by analysing strengths and weaknesses of different views before reaching your conclusion 5. Link your discussion of The Origins of the Universe to its real-world impact on believers and society | UK Context: In the UK, debates about often involve both religious and secular voices.
